scripts.generate: rm -rf generated && bun run prepare-openapi && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm:openapi-gen:*"
scripts.openapi-gen:rust:damm-v1: openapi-generator-cli --openapitools openapitools.rust.json generate -i .openapi/damm-v1.json -o generated/rust/damm-v1 -g rust --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=packageName=meteora-damm-v1-api-generated,supportAsync=true,hideGenerationTimestamp=true && bun scripts/generate-rust-client.ts damm-v1
scripts.openapi-gen:rust:damm-v2: openapi-generator-cli --openapitools openapitools.rust.json generate -i .openapi/damm-v2.json -o generated/rust/damm-v2 -g rust --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=packageName=meteora-damm-v2-api-generated,supportAsync=true,hideGenerationTimestamp=true && bun scripts/generate-rust-client.ts damm-v2
scripts.openapi-gen:rust:dlmm: openapi-generator-cli --openapitools openapitools.rust.json generate -i .openapi/dlmm.json -o generated/rust/dlmm -g rust --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=packageName=meteora-dlmm-api-generated,supportAsync=true,hideGenerationTimestamp=true && bun scripts/generate-rust-client.ts dlmm
scripts.openapi-gen:rust:dynamic-vault: openapi-generator-cli --openapitools openapitools.rust.json generate -i .openapi/dynamic-vault.json -o generated/rust/dynamic-vault -g rust --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=packageName=meteora-dynamic-vault-api-generated,supportAsync=true,hideGenerationTimestamp=true && bun scripts/generate-rust-client.ts dynamic-vault
scripts.openapi-gen:rust:stake2earn: openapi-generator-cli --openapitools openapitools.rust.json generate -i .openapi/stake2earn.json -o generated/rust/stake2earn -g rust --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=packageName=meteora-stake2earn-api-generated,supportAsync=true,hideGenerationTimestamp=true && bun scripts/generate-rust-client.ts stake2earn
scripts.prepare-openapi: rm -rf .openapi && mkdir .openapi && bun scripts/normalize-openapi.ts openapi/dlmm/openapi.json .openapi/dlmm.json && bun scripts/normalize-openapi.ts openapi/damm-v1/openapi.json .openapi/damm-v1.json && bun scripts/normalize-openapi.ts openapi/damm-v2/openapi.json .openapi/damm-v2.json && bun scripts/normalize-openapi.ts openapi/dynamic-vault/openapi.json .openapi/dynamic-vault.json && bun scripts/normalize-openapi.ts openapi/stake2earn/openapi.json .openapi/stake2earn.json
scripts.generate:rust: rm -rf generated/rust && bun run prepare-openapi && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm:openapi-gen:rust:*"
scripts.generate:ts: rm -rf generated/ts && bun run prepare-openapi && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm:openapi-gen:ts:*"
